item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of reminders to question your own thinking: Am I projecting? Does this moment support the life I'm building? Those are good questions, but they only work if you stop and answer them. Notice how often your mind predicts what others think or what will go wrong. Treat each prediction as a guess, not a fact. Action: at midday, pause, name one assumption you're making, and write down one other possible explanation.
